stories.title: Canonical authority stays on the true MuJoCo mainline
acceptance_criteria: Any detached run declares backend, robot_in_loop, control_baseline_ref, and canonical_next_action_at_launch
Wrong-line runs are marked invalidated instead of being left in running state

stories.title: True MuJoCo robot-in-loop env exposes a MINT-compatible contract
acceptance_criteria: The env loads Infinigen drawer URDF assets from sim_exports/urdf/drawerbox
The env supports reset, step, observe, and cleanup without PyBullet compatibility layers
Observations contain dual RGB images, state(8,), task text, and drawer progress

stories.title: MuJoCo rollouts pack directly into the canonical LeRobot dataset
acceptance_criteria: Oracle and AnyGrasp robot rollouts are saved with images, images2, states, actions, and JSON metadata
dataset_builder.build_dataset_from_rollouts ingests the MuJoCo rollouts without a schema migration
The pack artifact records rollout sources, seed coverage, task coverage, and frame count

stories.title: Night runner compares pretrained and fine-tuned MINT on the same MuJoCo env
acceptance_criteria: Fine-tuned MINT starts from upstream external/MINT@4eab579
The night runner emits pretrained-vs-finetuned held-out metrics from the same MuJoCo env
The final report records measured outcomes only and does not write new causal claims into claims.yaml
